description: Lineas de transmisión lineal is a dataset listed in Chilean national open data portal (datos.gob.cl), an open data portal, published or maintained by Subsecretaría de Energía. Localización y trazado de Sistema Eléctrico en las regiones de de Arica y Parinacota, Tarapacá, Antofagasta. Coverage: Chile. The portal files it under the publisher Subsecretaría de Energía. Its tags are Antofagasta., Arica y Parinacota, Lineas de transmisión lineal, Ministerio de energía, Tarapacá. The portal shows 2015-10-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Non-Commercial (Any). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-cl-portal.
